extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers/contributors (especially new editors attempting to create or locate an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements shown when a requested Wikipedia page does not exist, including account/status requirements to create pages, searching for alternative titles, checking deletion logs, and using the article-draft workflow or redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article directly because you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed, consider using the article wizard, submitting a draft for review, or requesting a new article via the indicated channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When you lack account privileges or prefer review before publication, follow the article wizard/draft workflow so experienced editors can review and help improve the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Curb Holocaust' in existing articles. Please search for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, look for existing coverage under variant spellings or similar titles to avoid duplication; use Wikipedia search to locate possible matches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' and internal link searches to find mentions that might point to an existing article or indicate the preferred title/coverage location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for database update delays for newly created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone else just created the page and it doesn't appear, wait briefly or purge the cache before creating what might be a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page might have been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate past deletions and deletion reasons to determine whether recreating the article is appropriate or requires addressing notability/other concerns first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify correct capitalization and create or request redirects from alternative capitalizations or common variants to the canonical article title to aid discoverability.
